'''Ueda''' was a remote [[planet]]<ref name="Databank Ueda">{{Databank|ueda|Ueda}}</ref> located in [[Xappyh sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Acolyte Visual Guide" /> Ueda was home to [[Point Ueda]], located on a small [[Color|green]] island connected via a landbridge to further land, where a landing pad was located. Within Point Ueda was the [[Lomi Usqi Noodle Shop]] by the late [[High Republic Era]].<ref name="Databank Lomi Usqi" /> Ueda was considered a haven for wanderers, many of whom would frequent the village of Point Ueda. It was inhabited by a diverse range of [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]], such as [[human]]s and aliens including  [[Duraceph]], [[Clarodian|Clarodians]], and [[Drezar]].<ref name="Lost Found" />

==History==
In [[132 BBY]], the [[Jedi Master]] [[Indara]] was stationed in a village in Ueda.<ref name="Timeline">{{TheAcolyteDate}}</ref> The [[Force-sensitive]] [[assassin]] [[Mae-ho Aniseya|Mae Aniseya]] tracked her to a bar and [[Indara's murder|confronted]] her, attacking several bystanders until Indara intervened to stop her. Mae killed Indara in the ensuing fight.<ref name="Lost Found" />
